item.title: Senate passes AI chip export crackdown aimed at China in 71-27 vote
item.description: The Senate passed a bill cracking down on exports of AI chips to China. Tech industry groups warned the rules could hurt US companies.

item.title: Hostage deal ceasefire talks resume in Cairo as pressure mounts
item.description: Ceasefire talks resumed in Cairo. Families of hostages urged negotiators to reach a deal quickly.

item.title: Governor signs school choice voucher expansion into law
item.description: The governor signed a school choice voucher expansion that lets families use state funds for private school tuition.
